note: Jackson County Conservation park, 43 acres on the Mississippi River 2 mi N of Bellevue (US 52, then 395th Ave). The campground spreads around the mouth of Spruce Creek, with sites on the river shore, along the creek and beside the boat harbor (87 leased slips, 5 transient docks); boat ramp, shelters, playground, campground attendants May-September and a resident host. --Claude
summary: County page and campground map read: $25 confirmed; 86 sites (1-86), all 50 amp; showers/flush/pit toilets, dump, hydrants; FCFS only; season May 1 - Oct (river levels). Riverfront stands: sites on the open Mississippi main-channel shore.
flags: RIVERFRONT STANDS (checked; the harbor is not the basis): the campground is not only on the harbor. The county map and imagery (0.31 m/px) put the east-point sites (roughly 62-64, 67, 69-70, 73-74) and the harbor-mouth strip sites (3-8) on the Mississippi main channel (~1 km+ wide), pads ending ~10-20 m from an open sand/grass shore with the loop roads behind them (west of the pads), no road, parking or day use between. ~12-15 on-water candidates. Sites along Spruce Creek (a ~15-25 m channel) and beside the harbor are creekside/harbor-view, not counted.
PIN (minor, under the 250 m line): stored 42.30180,-90.43300 sits on the water at the river edge of the harbor strip, ~180 m SE of the campground's middle; 42.3030,-90.4345 would centre it.
SITE COUNT: 86 from the 2019 county map (the park page says 80+).
SEWER: the park's feature list includes 'Sewer Connection', but nothing says which sites; left unset.
